title: Suspect in RPG attack on Maguindanao mayor arrested
summary: COTABATO CITY, BARMM, Philippines — Police arrested on Saturday one of the suspects in the Jan. 25, 2026 rocket-propelled grenade (RPG) attack targeting Shariff Aguak Mayor Akmad “Mitra” Ampatuan Sr.…

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY, BARMM, Philippines — Police arrested on Saturday one of the suspects in the Jan. 25, 2026 rocket-propelled grenade (RPG) attack targeting Shariff Aguak Mayor Akmad “Mitra” Ampatuan Sr. in Maguindanao del Sur. Major Joel Lebrilla, chief of the Shariff Aguak Municipal Police Station, identified the suspect as Toraipe Lusod, alias “Aripi Adam,” of Barangay Meta, Datu Unsay, Maguindanao del Sur. READ: Maguindanao mayor who survived RPG attack dares nephew to face raps Lusod was arrested at around 2:45 p.m. during a law enforcement operation in the area.
